title: SEBI warns listed firms, regulated entities against ‘Boss Scam’ involving CEO, MD impersonation
summary: SEBI has cautioned listed companies and regulated entities against so called “Boss Scam”, where cyber fraudsters impersonate as CEOs, MDs and other senior executives to trick finance employees into transferring funds.
